summary: Pooja is a seasoned CSM who came from Zoho implementations and genuinely owns onboarding for the mid-market pod; her playbook is used by peers. Her CRM logging is poor and a CS ops coordinator writes most of her activity entries from her dictation, so CRM hygiene is not her skill.

oracle.basis: doc_DOC-SALES-2231 onboarding playbook v3 with phase exit criteria and acceptance checks 'used by every CSM since v2' (187 views); sfdc_KC-10931 Onboarding opportunities 2021-2025 with go-live to acceptance; cv_2025_05 playbook used by 5 CSMs, mentoring 2 joiners; hcm self 3. Adopted playbook = K3 level 3 (exact).

skills.why: Wrote the pod's playbook with exit criteria and acceptance checks that other CSMs follow; onboarding opps show completed go-lives to criteria.

oracle.basis: sfdc_KC-10931 Renewal/Expansion records 2022-2026 with her risk actions (champion left -> mapped new FP&A head, exec sponsor call; uplift accepted after match-rate report; credit note save) and her own logged escalations; cv_2025_05 29 accounts, renewals. Independent renewal risk handling = K3 level 2; no coaching of account owners.

skills.why: Runs renewals and risk saves on 29 accounts alone; not reviewing other CSMs' account strategy except informal mentoring of two joiners.

oracle.basis: sfdc_KC-10931 activities: about one third created by her (462 of 1,393 by monthly counts), the rest by CS Ops Coordinator 'per Pooja' (not credited); her own entries are activity logs on assigned accounts, no stage or forecast maintenance; lms Salesforce for CS Teams (2023). Own updates without independent upkeep = K3 level 1 (exact). hcm self 3 not used.

skills.why: Under two fifths of the activity records are her own entries; most are written by the coordinator, so independent CRM upkeep is not shown.

oracle.basis: sfdc_KC-10931 her own activity records: exec sponsor calls, escalation with 4-hourly updates, new FP&A head mapped after champion left; cv_2025_05 'Stakeholder management', QBRs and exec sponsor calls. Work + self at 2.

skills.why: Exec sponsor calls, escalations with update cadence, backup owner rule; handled alone, not teaching negotiation.

oracle.basis: doc_DOC-SALES-2231 has four contributors (coordinator and two CSMs added sections) and doc_DOC-SALES-2307 two; her share of the writing is not separable; no validation records.

skills.why: Clear procedures with changelog and field fixes; used by colleagues, but nobody has measured task completion from it.

oracle.basis: No ServiceNow use of hers in the bundle; doc_DOC-SALES-2307 says a coordinator pulls the INC list.

skills.why: Raises tickets for customers as a requester only.
